content_item_id.description:
When given, the audio and timings are attached to that content item
so render_video mixes the narration in and shows word-timed captions.

text.description: The narration to voice (typically the beats of a write_script brief).

voice_id.description: ElevenLabs voice id; defaults to ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID.

license_attestation.description:
Your own declaration of the rights you hold for the listed URLs —
``{"license": ..., "permits_advertising": true, "authority": ..., "attribution":
...}``. Only supply it when you actually hold those rights.

limit.description: Maximum number of clips to return.

clip_path_or_url.description: Local audio path or http(s) URL of a rights-cleared clip.

license_attestation.description:
An explicit declaration that you hold advertising rights the
engine cannot see — ``{"license": ..., "permits_advertising": true, "authority":
..., "attribution": ...}``. It overrides the manifest check, so pass it only as a
deliberate act for material you really are licensed to use.

options.description:
Job options per API contract §2 (``stems``, ``transcribe``, ``drum_slices``,
``target_root_midi``, ``client_sample_rate``) plus ``source`` (provider name to
record, e.g. "free_music_archive"), ``license`` / ``attribution`` (as reported by
list_source_clips) and ``force`` (true reprocesses a known clip).

content_item_id.description: Id returned by process_clip (must have been rendered).

hashtags.description: Hashtags appended to the caption (with or without '#').

schedule_at.description: Optional RFC 3339 UTC time to publish at instead of now.

avatar_clip.description: Path or URL of the presenter video (required for presenter="avatar_clip").

presenter.description: Bottom half: an audio-reactive waveform or a supplied avatar clip.

scene.description: Top half: a stylised Tonamorph plugin UI or a DAW arrangement view.

since_iso.description: RFC 3339 timestamp; posts published before it are skipped.

accounts.description:
Platforms to publish to (instagram, facebook, tiktok, youtube); defaults to
every platform with credentials configured.

count.description: Number of new clips to process.

credit_budget.description:
Maximum credits this run may spend; defaults to GROWTH_CREDIT_BUDGET,
and without either the run is bounded by ``count`` and the balance floor.

angle.description: The creative angle: speed, bass, sample_flip or tutorial.

clip_metadata.description:
Fields such as ``title``, ``chosen_stem``, ``bpm``, ``key`` (string or
``{"root","mode"}``), ``note_count``, ``analysis`` (a JobResult analysis block),
and optionally ``content_item_id``.
